semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable dry-run profile has explicit identity.
semantics.effect_rule: Which validations/resolutions/planning/external calls are executed is explicit.
semantics.noeffect_rule: No-effect guarantee applies only when the exact operation/profile declares it.
semantics.result_rule: Dry-run produces predicted/candidate evidence distinct from real execution result.
semantics.destructive_rule: Destructive dry-run never performs destructive effect.
semantics.authority_rule: Dry-run still may require read/inspection authorization.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.
